rule: The waiting times the New Campaign setup screen states (MMR-43). Provisional values are the reference measurements recorded so far; MMR-56 replaces them with its end-to-end F03 measurements and adds the campaign-start phase once that action exists (MMR-46). The screen states a phase's upper measurement rounded up to roundToSeconds, and never promises a time it has no measurement for; a run that takes longer adds its measurement.
